Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master's entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon and something new awakens within her.

All he has are non-combat skills such as "Appraisal". From a hopeless situation, he is saved by encounters, and his all-powerful abilities blossom. An another world adventure tale of miraculous reversal cheats burst forth.

video:video.video:title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
video:video.video:description: On our third wedding anniversary, my husband divorced me and I was publicly humiliated by his mistress. They said I wasn't worthy of being in their presence. Little did they know, I'm the daughter of the richest man in the States, and all of my ex-husband's resources came from me. Luckily on the same day, I accidentally ended up marrying a dashing billionaire. Now, I have wealth, leisure, a handsome husband, and another mysterious identity. Can anyone top that? Just wait.

video:video.video:title: The Cleaning Lady Is CEO
video:video.video:description:
"Sleep with me, otherwise you'll be fired."The manager slaps a cleaner to the ground, threatening her.
The cleaning lady stands up. She takes off the coat and pulls out a VIP card , "Guess who is getting fired? You!"
The manager is instantly stunned, collapsing to the floor in shock. Trembling, he asks, "That's the CEO's VIP card! You are the CEO?！"

video:video.video:title: President's Sexy Wife
video:video.video:description: Heiress of the Lawrence family, Gianna couldn't believe it when she found her fiance had been cheating on her with her half-sister. Heartbroken, she went to get drunk in a bar, but ended up spending a passionate night with a hot guy named Logan. It was only until the next morning that she realized Logan was the owner of the Solomon Group and that she, under the influence, had signed a marriage contract with him.

video:video.video:title: Crush on the Unwanted Princess
video:video.video:description: My world turned upside down when I was asked to go undercover, posing as a poor student dating a prince. Twists, secrets, and a crime syndicate later, I find out the truth is far more shocking than I could have imagined—I'm indeed a PRINCESS!

video:video.video:title: The Virgin and The Billionaire
video:video.video:description: Desperate to save her dying mother, Cindy Parks strikes a deal with her boss’s daughter, Nikki Jenkins: Pretend to be Nikki and give her virginity to billionaire Charles Kane. Nikki uses the scheme to trick Charles into marrying her but when she gets sick, Cindy is once again forced to play dress up and step in as a replacement bride.

video:video.video:title: All I Want Is You
video:video.video:description: Rosalie, a brave violinist, saves Damien from bullies in high school, leaving him with a cherished bracelet as a token. Ten years later, fate reunites them through a contract marriage orchestrated by Damien’s grandfather. Despite their initial clashes and misunderstandings, their bond deepens as Damien searches for his long-lost savior, unaware Rosalie is Rory. Betrayal, jealousy, and danger test their relationship, but love prevails when Damien discovers the truth. Their journey from resentment to passion culminates in a heartfelt reunion proving destiny's unbreakable ties.

video:video.video:title: The Back of the Unwanted Bride
video:video.video:description: “One night shattered her perfect life; a decade later, she returns with a billionaire's secret son and rewrites her destiny."

video:video.video:title: How to Tame a Silver Fox [English]
video:video.video:description: Harper Reeves is just trying to finish up her senior year of Yale without being a completely friendless loser. However, when her party's suddenly crashed by her dad's best friend and mysterious business partner, Chris Collins, she realizes she'd much rather have been busted by the cops. Chris, always in over-protective mode, gets on Harper's nerves, until she realizes he needs to go. Together with her best friend Maria, she brainstorms Operation Seduction, planning to get Chris to fall in love with her so her dad will kick him out himself. But every time Chris saves Harper from trouble, she gets closer to realizing she may have feelings for him after all.

video:video.video:title: Divorce to Be the Top Heiress
video:video.video:description: Julia almost lost her life for her husband Klaus. However, she discovered that Klaus had cheated and had a child with another woman. Disheartened, she divorce and reclaim her true identity as the granddaughter of the worlds richest man...Klaus had always deeply loved Julia. He thought Julia had fallen for another man, so he deliberately pretended to cheat and got a divorce, giving her freedom. However, he could never truly let her go in his heart...

video:video.video:title: Adored by the CEO
video:video.video:description: Adrian Reeves was in desperate need of money due to family pressure. In pursuit of a high-paying job, she disguised herself as a man and became the special assistant to the CEO of a Fortune 500 company. The CEO, Raymond Shaw, was constantly pressured by his grandmother to get married, which led him to hire a male special assistant to prevent his grandmother from arranging various women as his personal secretary. But the CEO doesn’t know that his special assistant was actually a woman.And thus, began a comical love story…

video:video.video:title: A Matter of Sin and Love
video:video.video:description: Ten years ago Christian adopted the enemy's daughter Elena. Ten years later, they fell in love with each other.

video:video.video:title: Get into Bed with My Husband's Best Friend
video:video.video:description: On her way home one day, Bella discovered that her husband Luis was having sex with his step-sister Caroline in the car. So she made up her mind to take revenge on Luis. With the help of her best friend, she approached Adrian, Luis's best friend and also his rival...

video:video.video:title: The Bride of the Wolf King
video:video.video:description: My husband, the Wolf King, even if you don’t recognize me after the reincarnation, I will still find you and fall in love with you.

video:video.video:title: Ms. Janitor Turned CEO
video:video.video:description: The female CEO disguises herself as a janitor to inspect the company, but little did she expect to be bullied by the manager. The manager dirties her clothes and even slaps her, threatening to fire her. In that moment, she takes off her coat and reveals a VIP card, saying, Take a good look at who I am. Who will be the one getting fired? You!

video:video.video:title: No Escape From My Ruthless Alpha
video:video.video:description: "I only want her. She's my mate."Ella, a wolf-less maid, is forced to marry the ruthless Alpha Logan instead of her sister. She soon discovers that Logan is her mate and that he's not as bad as everyone says. As she falls in love with him, Ella finds out she's actually a royal princess...

video:video.video:title: The Rejected Luna Returns with a Son
video:video.video:description: Sia returns with her son five years after divorcing Alpha Reagon, only to find that--Reagon never divorced her and he hates her! Reagon makes Sia work as a stripper, believing that she betrayed him five years ago. Reagon may be able to force himself to punish her, he cannot force himself to stop loving her. If only Reagon knew that Sia loves him, and that her son is actually his...

video:video.video:title: The Alpha King Is My Second Mate
video:video.video:description: Sasha is about to wed Alpha Spencer, but she’s rejected at the altar. As soon as Spencer makes her a slave, the handsome and powerful Alpha King Xander saves her and says he is her second mate! Poor Sasha can't believe it and she only wants to flee. But the Alpha King spoils her like a princess. She can’t help but fall in love with him. However, the Moon Goddess must be playing a joke on Sasha--Xander has vowed to kill Sasha’s kind because of the power she has.

video:video.video:title: Return of the Lady CEO
video:video.video:description: Rich family Neil’s favorite daughter Catherine was drugged to have sex with a stranger, which was considered a disgrace to the family integrity. After being disinherited by her father, Catherine found out her own sister Renee and fiance Howard were behind all these to set her up and she was then pushed off the roof by them. Eight years later, Catherine came back to the city alive becoming lady CEO of a company to seek for revenge from her enemies. To promise her son a loving family, Catherine contract-married with the stranger father, George Donton, a powerful royal family heir but mistakenly taken as a pizza delivery driver by her. With the discreet help from the Donton family, and a dangerous accident that George saved her life, Catherine finally found out the truth about him and decided to love him with her heart. They joined hands to beat the evils over and restored the peace to the city...

video:video.video:title: Love Again, My Princess
video:video.video:description: In my previous life, I mistrusted my driver’s son, who stole my money with his evil girlfriend and injected HIV into me!!! Now I’m reborn back to school, I will make him taste all the pain he’s given me, expose him in front of everyone for the crap he’s done, and get back in love with my handsome admirer, NYC’s top billionaire!

video:video.video:title: Found a Homeless Lycan to Be My Mate
video:video.video:description: To escape Vincent’s harassment, Isabella holds a tournament to find a strong warrior to marry. Unexpectedly, an unknown rogue named Ethan, accompanied by his daughter Lily, wins the competition and becomes Isabella’s mate. But Ethan is not just any rogue. He is Lycan.After the two switch roles, Vincent launches a surprise attack, forcing Isabella into a desperate battle. In order not to burden Ethan and Lily, Isabella chooses to face Vincent alone, but is quickly overwhelmed and faces imminent danger. At the critical moment, Ethan then easily defeats Vincent—becoming the hero who saves the damsel in distress.

video:video.video:title: Love Never Fades
video:video.video:description: Su Ye was framed by Su Ling, the adopted daughter of the Su family, and had a one-night stand with Qin Chongzhou, the president of the Qin family. Five years later, she returned with her children. She must make those enemies pay the price!

video:video.video:title: Love by Confinement
video:video.video:description: Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

video:video.video:title: Desired by the Billionaire Football Star
video:video.video:description: A billionaire NFL quarterback star issues a nationwide manhunt for the woman he had a one-night stand with.

video:video.video:title: My Quintuplets Have Four Dads
video:video.video:description: An ordinary girl accidentally saved a CEO. No one knew about the romance, but her identity was taken away by her gold-digging girlfriend. Afterwards, she was blessed with five babies! These genius babies became the fuse of love.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Williams! Madame Is Dying
video:video.video:description: Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

video:video.video:title: The Female CEO Turned Janitor
video:video.video:description: Who would have thought that the cleaning lady before our eyes is actually a female CEO with a net worth of trillions...

video:video.video:title: My Ex-Wife Is a Superwoman
video:video.video:description: She was everything I thought I understood—my wife, my partner, my equal. But after the divorce, I realized how little I truly knew about her. Behind the quiet strength she displayed during our marriage lies an extraordinary world I never imagined. As a renowned figure with unparalleled talents and a heart devoted to justice, she’s not just a woman but a force to be reckoned with. Watching her thrive from a distance, I can’t help but feel a mix of admiration, regret, and longing. She’s my ex-wife, but to the world, she’s a superwoman—and I’m still hopelessly in her orbit.

video:video.video:title: Prisoner of Love
video:video.video:description: Jason, new at Berlin Schwingert High, intrigued Joe. Joe, unaware he fell for a boy, felt drawn to Jasons depth. They discussed freedom and frequented their secret rooftop. Meanwhile, Joe, an avid chess player, bonded with an online opponent, whom he mistakenly assumed was a girl, sharing his feelings with Barron.

video:video.video:title: Flash Marriage with my Alpha
video:video.video:description: Pregnant and rejected by my alpha mate. Today I had my first one night stand. It wasn't planned. It was also with a complete stranger. As I lay in bed, I paused when a familiar sense washed over me. The other side, my boyfriend, Ethan, was nearby, and he wasn't alone.You are so tight, girl, Only for you...

video:video.video:title: Revenge on my ex-husband
video:video.video:description: My ex-husband must die

video:video.video:title: I Can Never be Yours
video:video.video:description: When fresh-faced college graduate Sheryl Davis has a one-night stand with billionaire Liam Anderson on New Years Eve, she never expects to become his secretary – or watch him mistake her best friend for his mystery woman! As their office chemistry sizzles, Sheryl discovers shes pregnant! Will Liam realize his perfect match has been right in front of him all along?

video:video.video:title: Lycan Princess Won't Be Your Luna
video:video.video:description: Alyssa, the lost princess of the powerful Obsidian Pack, awakens her hidden Lycan heritage after surviving a brutal attack. For years, she endured humiliation as the wolfless Luna of the Silver Moon Pack, married to Alpha Alaric in a contract to stabilize his cursed pack. When she discovers Alaric’s betrayal—his pregnant mistress and his family’s disdain—Alyssa leaves, reclaiming her royal identity. Reunited with her brother, the Lycan King, she uncovers a witchcraft conspiracy that suppressed her and Alaric’s powers. As they confront their past and a vengeful witch, Alyssa must choose between reclaiming her love or forging her own path as a leader. A tale of betrayal, destiny, and fierce redemption.

video:video.video:title: Return of that Banished Girl
video:video.video:description: Isabella grew up in a patriarchal home where she and her sister were mistreated in favor of their brother. Despite the odds, she got into Harvard but was forced to quit. With her mother’s help, she left, finished school, and became CEO. When she learned her family planned to marry off her sister to fund her brother’s marriage, she returned to save her mother and sister—this time, determined to fight back.

video:video.video:title: Reborn to Revenge: The Betrayed Luna
video:video.video:description: Melinda encountered Phillips and Laura, restraining her urge to confront them. She bumped into Nelson, who realized she was his Mate. Nelson's longing for her overwhelmed him as she walked away, leaving him in a maddening heartbeat.

video:video.video:title: From XL to Extra Love
video:video.video:description: Kate Harris, once an overlooked, plus-size dreamer, lands a job at Reynolds Group and meets the CEO of her fantasies—the effortlessly charming Lucas Reynolds. But her fairytale crashes when she’s framed for plagiarism by the jealous office queen Chloe, and Lucas, deceived by appearances, fires her on the spot. Crushed but not defeated, Kate takes a dangerous weight-loss drug and reemerges with a new identity and a stunning transformation.

video:video.video:title: Legally Bound To Love
video:video.video:description: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Right Person, Wrong Time
video:video.video:description: When the love was so deep that it was difficult to separate, in order to save her mother, she was forced to appear in court and gave false testimony, sending the person she loved most to jail. Now that you are the CEO, there is a huge difference between us. But the flame of love was ignited again.

video:video.video:title: Head Over Heels With My Substitute Wifey
video:video.video:description: Due to a reckless incident where Grace White's younger sister, Amber White, drove under the influence, Woods Group CEO Richard Woods' sister, Alice Woods, has fallen into a coma. Grace's father and malicious stepmother hold her mother's funeral urn hostage, coercing her to marry Richard Woods in Alice's stead to make up for that incident. Little do they know that Grace has already shared an intimate encounter with Richard previously.

video:video.video:title: Nikita: Alpha Kings 3-Time Rejected Mate
video:video.video:description: Nikita, a she-wolf from the poorest, weakest New Moon Pack, unexpectedly became the destined mate of the newly appointed Alpha King Vincent Spencer the day after her boyfriend betrayed her. Having been rejected three times before, Nikita had lost faith in love. She wanted to refuse Alpha King Vincent, but he adamantly disagreed. He recognized her as his savior and had fallen for her at first sight.Simultaneously, Nikita discovered that her parents had been brutally murdered, and their killer was hiding within the wealthiest, most powerful Full Moon Pack under Vincents rule. In order to avenge her parents, Nikita reluctantly agreed to become Alpha King Vincents mate and infiltrate the Full Moon Pack for investigation. Thus began a journey of love and bloodshed...

video:video.video:title: The Wallflower And The Alphas
video:video.video:description: Avery Williams is a high school senior wallflower and a transforming werewolf who has two identities inside. One is a wolf, the other is a Veela. Avery tries to handle her werewolf instinct, especially as the approaching mating time drives her out of control.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Secret Love
video:video.video:description: Fifteen years ago, Gu Junxu met a girlBut when she appeared in front of him many years later, he...

video:video.video:title: Too Late to Regret, Ex-Hubby
video:video.video:description: Olivia Sterling lived in a loveless marriage with her cold and arrogant husband, James Sterling, for seven years. During this period, she witnessed her son Henry being gradually taken away by James ex - girlfriend, Victoria Clark. Olivia became an outsider. At Henrys birthday party, Olivia found herself completely ignored, and then proposed divorce that night. After leaving the cage named marriage, Olivia picked up her work as a talented translator of Joyce again and became closer with her friends brother, Tom Whitmore. At this time, James and son Henry wanted to win Olivia back, but found that the woman who was once regarded as insignificant by them was now out of their reach.

video:video.video:title: Wealthy Marriage Encounter: Mystery Tycoon
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by her fiancé, Shu Yunjin quickly got married

video:video.video:title: Sinful Love With Alphas
video:video.video:description: Adea, a prophetic female werewolf, navigates her dreams sensual mysteries. Encountering her persistent stepbrother Shane at Half Moons den, intrigue ensues. Amidst Shanes pursuit, the arrival of stepfather Joshua and his wife unravels hidden truths. A tale of desire, secrets, and family bonds awaits.

video:video.video:title: My Scar, His Debt to Pay
video:video.video:description: Rachel and Ethan were trapped in a war zone. While trying to save Ethan, Rachel was left with a disfiguring scar on her face. They fell in love and got married, but there was only one evacuation spot. Rachel gave it to the injured Ethan, and Ethan promised he would come back for her—unaware that Rachel later discovered she was pregnant. Six years later, Rachel returns to the country to save her daughter, Sophie, only to find that Ethan had already married the hospital director’s daughter and started a new family after his return. To protect his reputation and status, Ethan even slandered Rachel and Sophie. At this critical moment, Rachel’s long-lost father finds her and reveals that she is actually the daughter of the chairman of the Harrington Medical Group. In the end, the scumbag doctor loses everything and suffers the consequences of his own actions, while Rachel goes on to live a happy life with her daughter.

video:video.video:title: I Said Yes to Danger
video:video.video:description: Ruth Allen is always blamed and framed because of her sister. Desperate to escape her toxic family, she wishes to marry her parents' enemy—then, to her shock, it actually happens! Life as a daughter is hard, but life as the enemy's wife? Thrilling. She fights back, takes revenge, and finally claims her own life.

video:video.video:title: The Divorced Heiress Claims Her Crown
video:video.video:description: Caroline, the beloved heiress of the Donovan family and sister to three protective brothers, was born into a life of privilege. But for love, she concealed her identity and married Hayden, quietly supporting his rise for three years.Until betrayal struck — during a life-threatening childbirth, Hayden chose to save another woman’s child over hers. Heartbroken but resolute, Caroline divorced him, took her daughter, and began to rebuild her life. Now, Hayden must face the painful road to winning her back.

video:video.video:title: Seduce My Ex's Brother-in-Law
video:video.video:description: After heartbreak and family collapse, piano teacher Emily is forced into the world of the elite to save her father. An unexpected encounter with Ethan,the sharp and enigmatic lawyer of the Hawthorne family, leads them to pose as lovers.But as trials, secrets, and betrayals surface, their staged romance grows dangerously real. Emily must summon courage and wit to fight back against the forces determined to destroy her family and future.

video:video.video:title: Daddy’s Kisses? No Thanks!
video:video.video:description: She and he met unexpectedly. Six years later, he was looking for his son, and her relationship with him warmed up in the company group. After all the twists and turns, can the little baby return to his father?

video:video.video:title: Fated to My Bad Boy Alpha
video:video.video:description: Abigail, a wolfless orphan, never expected that her mate would be Alpha Axel—the most infamous playboy in school.Just as they fall in love and start planning their future, Axel's ex-girlfriend returns, claiming she’s pregnant with his child……

video:video.video:title: Taming My Billionaire's Ruthless Desire
video:video.video:description: Jade Garrison, once the adopted daughter of the wealthy Garrison family, faces betrayal and cruelty after the return of Olivia, the biological daughter. Framed and abandoned by her husband, Samuel Fisher, Jade leaves with their unborn child. Five years later, she returns to save her son but is forced into servitude by Samuel. As secrets unravel—Olivia’s manipulations, Samuel’s hidden love, and Jade’s true lineage as the lost heiress of the Carey family—their painful past collides with a chance for redemption. A tale of love, revenge, and forgiveness, where scars heal only when pride falls.

video:video.video:title: Never Mess with Mom
video:video.video:description: She, a quiet laborer toiling tirelessly on a construction site. All she wanted was to give her daughter a normal, peaceful life. But when her daughter was humiliated, bullied, and finally kidnapped at the prestigious school, her rage ignited. The once-invincible warrior who once shook the world, after twelve years in hiding, returned for her daughter! In a single night, the four great families bowed in submission, the underground organization The Mafia was obliterated, and even the Russian mob trembled in terror! They finally understood…The most fearsome wrath does not belong to the powerful and influential—but to a mother who would tear the world apart for her daughter! This is a mothers battlefield. Now betrayed she returns to reclaim it all!

video:video.video:title: A Deal With The Hockey Captain
video:video.video:description: Nerdy college girl Dora joins the hockey team as an assistant, secretly in love with Leo. After a humiliating rejection, she makes a deal with team captain Troy to help her win Leo's heart. As Dora transforms and gains confidence, sparks fly with Troy. But secrets, sabotage, and shifting feelings complicate everything.

video:video.video:title: The Last Alpha
video:video.video:description: Sometimes fate is forbidden...Alina is heartbroken when she walks in on her boyfriend of 3 years in bed with anotherwoman. When her best friend forces her out of her depression to attend a party of an elitecouple Logan and Madeline who are hiding their true identities, the last thing Alina expectedwas to end up as an object of their desires...Logan is the last remaining Alpha of his kind.

video:video.video:title: A Love Paid in Tears
video:video.video:description: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

video:video.video:title: Watch Out! I Call the Final Shots
video:video.video:description: After being cast aside by the woman he helped rise to power, Arthur Storm—secret CEO of the powerful Titan Group—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.

video:video.video:title: CEO, Your Wife Runs Away with Your Six Heirs
video:video.video:description: After a night of passion, Evelyn Tomas gives birth to sextuplets. Six years later, a lovely boy stops billionaire Ethan Huntington and hands him a paternity test paper. He corners her and forces her to give him the child.

video:video.video:title: Stolen Heiress, Unstolen Love
video:video.video:description: Rebecca, a secret billionaire heiress, turned down an marriage to a powerful tycoon for her boyfriend of 10 years—only to catch him cheating with her best friend right in the office. The two, thinking they outranked her, subjected Rebecca to ruthless workplace bullying. Finally, she tossed her black card and revealed her true identity as their big boss, the two kneel in regret, begging for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Leonardo, the suitor Rebecca rejected, infiltrates the company to investigate his fiancée. Will he be able to recognize Rebecca? And can they finally fulfill their unfinished marriage?

video:video.video:title: Spark My Body and Master My Soul
video:video.video:description: College student Anna is betrayed by her boyfriend, who tries to sell her virginity at a club. Business tycoon Ryder saves her... but then invites her to sign a BDSM contract, making her his "Kitten". Little does he know that she's actually the angel who saved him when they were young - the one he's spent a decade searching for.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping for 30 years, My Brothers Kneel for me
video:video.video:description: Adopted by the Grayson family, May once enjoyed the love of three overprotective older brothers and the warmth of a happy home. However, after the Grayson family’s biological daughter Stella returned, May was treated as a “stand-in” and suffered betrayal and coldness. Misunderstandings and repeated emotional wounds left her heartbroken and disillusioned. Eventually, she volunteered to become a test subject in the “The May Project,” choosing to go into deep sleep for thirty years ...

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] My Prince From Another Time [English]
video:video.video:description: After transmigrating into the body of a 220-pound woman with magical spatial abilities, Emma Murray decides to first find a man and then establish herself as the leader of a mountain stronghold. Following a casual romantic encounter that unexpectedly results in quintuplets, she lives contentedly for six years until her children unexpectedly meet their father. Believing Matthias Caldwell to be merely a male courtesan from a place called Auster House, Emma convinces him to stay and marry her. However, on their wedding day, she discovers her new husband is actually a prince! Emma dramatically falls to the ground, lamenting, “You were supposed to be my mountain husband! How are you a prince?”

video:video.video:title: Agents' Undercovered Love
video:video.video:description: During a mission, Agent Noah had the intelligence hidden in jewelry stolen by Agent Olivia, who was disguised as a blonde, blue-eyed high-end escort. The two also had a one-night stand. Seven years later, they meet again without recognizing each other. They get married to maintain their covers as agents, only to fall in love later. Eventually, Noah discovers that Olivia's seven-year-old daughter Lucy is actually his biological child.

video:video.video:title: My Mute Bride With Many Secrets
video:video.video:description: The story revolves around Aster Lance's journey to locate her mom, which leads her to wed the affluent Simon Faust. Life's been tough for Aster since she was a kid. Her stepmom made her silent by poisoning her, so she couldn't speak. Luckily, a skilled physician helped her get her voice back and taught her a lot about alternative medicine techniques.

video:video.video:title: The Odyssey
video:video.video:description: The Odyssey

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Destiny's Keeper
video:video.video:description: He was clearly the strongest man in the world, yet he was mistaken for a beggar

video:video.video:title: If I Can't Hear You
video:video.video:description: I was born with inferiority. Nothing but unfriendly laughters filled in my whole life. I have to welcome a rebirth, a true self of mine is about to bring my husband a truely mental torture.

video:video.video:title: Please, Marry My Husband
video:video.video:description: Clara devoted twenty years to her husband and raised his two children, only to be betrayed by them all. Her husband plans a wedding—with her best friend as the bride, her own children standing by their side. Broken and humiliated, Clara decides to disappear, leaving behind a severance letter and a box filled with secrets—proof of everything they’ve done to her. But just when they think she’s gone for good, the wedding is interrupted by the one person they never expected to return. Love, guilt, and revenge explode in this twisted story of betrayal and rebirth.

video:video.video:title: Winning Back The Ex
video:video.video:description: Sheng Mian woke up to find herself lying in the same bed with her husband Fu Yancheng whom she had not seen in three years since marriage. She recalled being asked by her stepmother to toast Fu Yancheng last night, and after drinking, she became unconscious. She was momentarily embarrassed and prepared to flee, but was unexpectedly accused by Fu Yancheng of being a scheming woman. Obviously, he did not recognize herself as his wife.

video:video.video:title: Second Life, the Godfather's Wife
video:video.video:description: During the appointment ceremony for the leader of the Moretti family, Eleanor's fiancé Lucian assassinated the leader, while Eleanor's sister Vivian was jealous of her sister and killed Eleanor, both of whom died. Ten years ago, they chose the day of their fiancé and lived a new life. Eleanor only wanted to live an ordinary life and chose to marry a beggar, while Vivian married Lucian. Unexpectedly, the beggar whom Vivian initially sneered at was actually the renowned Godfather. After enduring hardships, Eleanor finally became Godfather's Wife.

video:video.video:title: The Heiress' Return: Three Brothers at Her Beck and Call
video:video.video:description: Refusing to settle for mediocrity within her esteemed family, Mia Gale, daughter of the affluent Gale family, rejects the indulgent lifestyle offered by her three brothers. Instead, she opts to pursue her own path, determined to carve out success through hard work and dedication.

video:video.video:title: The War God Returns
video:video.video:description: The saga of protagonist Chen Tianji unfolds as he suffers a severe trauma after being condemned by his senior brother and his wife, and upon awakening, he realizes that he has not only lost his precious Immortal Herb, but has also been wrongly accused and expelled from his master's school. In a moment of despair, he accidentally discovers a mysterious heavenly book left to him by his father, which becomes the turning point of his destiny. With the power of the heavenly book, Chen Tianji embarks on a path of revenge and self-transcendence!

video:video.video:title: Weapons! Women! Wild West!
video:video.video:description: Joey, a modern-day underdog loser, is suddenly transported into a Wild West game world set during the era of westward expansion and the American Civi War—only to find himself reborn as a penniless cowboy. Forced to accept a main quest titled "Become the King of the Wild Frontier,” he is assigned three female war captives and bound to an affection-based game system.By increasing their favorability, Joey can unlock modern weapons and skills.

video:video.video:title: I can hear you
video:video.video:description: She lost her hearing because of him, but he doesn't know the truth.

video:video.video:title: The Long-Lost Heiress in the House
video:video.video:description: At five, tycoon’s daughter Jenny Sinclair and slum girl Margaret Green swapped lives in a riot. Raised as “Margaret,” Jenny endured abuse while the real Margaret lived as Anna Sinclair. Years later, a DNA test exposes the lie, destroying Anna’s schemes. Reunited on Thanksgiving, Jenny reclaims her family and a new beginning.

video:video.video:title: Crossing the Line to Love
video:video.video:description: Three days before her wedding, freelance writer Nichole catches her fiancé in bed with her bridesmaid. In a moment of heartbreak and rage, she storms into a bar and kisses a random stranger—only to realize he's Fabian Winston, a wildly popular contemporary artist and the sole heir to a powerful elite family. The kiss goes viral overnight. Faced with mounting public pressure and relentless media, Nichole is pushed into a contract marriage with Fabian.

video:video.video:title: Enemies With Benefits: The CEO's Matchmaker Strikes [English]
video:video.video:description: To save her home, matchmaker Emma disguises herself as the wealthy billionaire Chase's dating prospect. But she never expected that he would fall for her, relentlessly pursuing her and refusing to let her go.

video:video.video:title: CEO, The Maid is Your Stunning Wife
video:video.video:description: As an adopted daughter, she had to marry a paralyzed wealthy old man in order to save her grandmother who had been raising her. However, due to her severe myopia, she recognized the wrong man on the wedding day, and her husband left the country in a hurry after getting the marriage certificate. A year later, she came to a big villa to work as a maid. The famous young president happened to return to China. Although they had never met before, she felt that the president looked strangely familiar...

video:video.video:title: The Zombie Dating System
video:video.video:description: When the zombie apocalypse erupts, Mike is murdered by his wife Sarah and best friend Ethan. He wakes as a zombie with a bizarre romance system: win women's affection, earn powers. His target, Jessie, keeps trying to kill him, until desire, revenge, and undead armies turn enemies into lovers.

video:video.video:title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter
video:video.video:description: Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York's underworld. At eighteen, he took control. By thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family.So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life.Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past.Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Threatened and terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. She has no idea what he used to be. Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her.Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives.The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack's arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo's driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power. Now someone has hurt his daughter.Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel—the Godfather whose name still commands fear and loyalty.Old enemies gather. Former allies return. The Colombos come for blood. Leonardo must decide how far he will go to protect the family he sacrificed everything to build. They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather.And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?

video:video.video:title: (Dubbed) Got X-Ray Vision? Try Treasure Empire!
video:video.video:description: Mia gains X-ray vision from a magic stone by accident, transforming from an ordinary worker into a legend. She masters Stone Gambling, confronts rivals, and hunts for five Magic Stones to unlock skills. With allies, she restores national treasures and takes on the gang, reaching the top of antique world, but her greatest achievement is yet to come.

video:video.video:title: Punch me baby
video:video.video:description: Daisy, the main character, had been married to her husband, Kelvin, for years but remained childless. Unwilling to reveal his azoospermia, Kelvin secretly arranged for a sperm donor to get her pregnant. Meanwhile, Daisy struggled with her mother’s serious illness and Kelvin’s infidelity. One day, Daisy saved Rowan, the male protagonist, from a gangster’s attack, and he fell in love with her at first sight. Rowan secretly chose her as his contractual wife. When he discovered her pregnancy, he mistakenly believed she had been unfaithful. Heartbroken, he drowned his sorrows in alcohol, nearly giving the second female lead a chance to take Daisy’s place in his life. It wasn’t until Daisy was kidnapped that Rowan finally uncovered the truth—Daisy’s child was actually his. In the end, Rowan rescued her.

video:video.video:title: Against the Tide: A Youth Rewritten
video:video.video:description: Given a second chance at life, she was determined to rewrite her fate. First, she took her sisters and completely shook off their past identities as delinquents, resolutely breaking up with her incompatible boyfriend to start a brand-new life. By a stroke of luck, she saved someones life, and this person later took the initiative to offer tutoring to them, bringing a turning point to their academic pursuits.

video:video.video:title: Country Girl，CEO’s Wife.
video:video.video:description: Olivia Charles is a young woman from the countryside who comes to the city to work. On her first night in the city, she is maliciously set up by her fellow villager Sabrina and, by accident, ends up having a one-night stand with a billionaire, Chandler Harrision. Because neither of them saw each other's face clearly, Sabrina pretended to be Chandler Harrision's girlfriend, hoping to marry into wealth. Olivia, relying on her own abilities, successfully lands a job as a housekeeper at the Chandler Harrision's hotel, and accidentally discover that the man she had a one-night stand with is her new boss. Olivia then finds out she is pregnant with his child, making matters more complicated.

video:video.video:title: Never Meeting You After the Rain
video:video.video:description: After 7 years of hard work, the scumbag divorced her just to register Bai Yueguang's child? This time, she turned away in despair, and was later embraced by her childhood sweetheart and married in a wedding dress. The scumbag begged her to come back with red eyes, but she only said coldly, I don't love you anymore.

video:video.video:title: My Father, The Secret Mogul
video:video.video:description: Kyle Webster, a thriving entrepreneur, is caught off guard when he unexpectedly encounters his father, Bryan Webster, a security guard, at a prestigious banquet. While the guests assume that the organizer is simply honoring Bryan out of respect for Kyle’s status, Bryan's unrefined behavior consistently puts Kyle in awkward predicaments.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Sky's New Dawn
video:video.video:description: She dreamed of becoming a pilot but unexpectedly had a child with him, leading her to give up her aspirations and choose to be a devoted wife and mother. Seven years into their marriage, she discovered that he had someone else and witnessed him pledging eternal love to another woman. Heartbroken, she met her end in a plane crash. However, she unexpectedly found herself reborn, back before the disaster, and vowed to change her fate…

video:video.video:title: Married My Twin Sister's Husband
video:video.video:description: Shen Meng's twin sister, Shen Fei, died in Shen Meng's arms after a miscarriage when she just got married for three months. Because the Qin family is so powerful that it is easy to cover the truth, Shen Meng decides not to call the police and pretends to be her sister herself to marry into the Qin family, using her own methods to find the truth.

video:video.video:title: Fading Facades: Love Beyond the Deal (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Qiana Cooper, born into a prestigious family, hides her identity to break free from her father's excessive indulgence. She travels to Green Land intending to marry John Collins, aspiring to lead an independent life. However, John becomes enamored with Cindy Smith, who portrays herself as an aristocrat. To ascend the social hierarchy, John divorces Qiana. Fueled by anger, Qiana enters into a marriage contract with Jack James, who happens to be in need of a partner.

video:video.video:title: Chasing the Guilty Wife: The Indifferent CEO Knows
video:video.video:description: The maid Luo Wanwan turned around and became the wife of a wealthy family, but she was framed and killed by the male protagonist's biological eldest brother. She was tortured and escaped. Five years later, Luo Wanwan returned to China again to find out the truth of what happened back then. Her scumbag boyfriend also changed his feelings and finally led a happy life.

video:video.video:title: Escape From my Destined Husband
video:video.video:description: After breaking the debauchery of her ex-boyfriend, Eve grabs a "call-boy" into a flash marriage directly on that spot . But actually, this man is Eve's FIANCE！

video:video.video:title: Chasing My Frozen Wife
video:video.video:description: On her mother’s funeral day, Amber discovered her husband’s betrayal. After seven years of pursuit and fifty proposals, their marriage crumbled under lies and neglect. On their anniversary, heartbroken, she chose to freeze herself —leaving behind only her husbands bitter regret and unbearable remorse.

video:video.video:title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
video:video.video:description: The female boss of the Scorpion Gang, Cathy, was deliberately involved in a car accident and fell into a coma. As soon as she woke up, she was tricked by the family elders into bringing back Prince Alexander of Monaco as a sperm donor in order to have an heir. The two started out disliking each other but gradually developed feelings for each other. Little did they know that Alexander was Cathy's childhood sweetheart and they had both been looking for each other.

video:video.video:title: Her Favorite Dessert is Her Chef
video:video.video:description: After an award winning chef Valerie loses her partner and girlfriend to each other, they kick her out of her own restaurant leaving her with nothing. But her luck changes when she has a one nightstand with a gorgeous CEO named Isabella who turns out to be her cheating ex-businesses partner’s stepmother.

video:video.video:title: Throne and Kin
video:video.video:description: The Sterling family, led by Edward Sterling, is exposed for their involvement in power struggles and a grain monopoly conspiracy. Thomas Sterling conspires with Lord Ashford in a rebellion, leading to a rift between mother and son. Margaret Benson unveils their crimes and aids the common people, earning the support of His Majesty the Emperor. Her Majesty the Empress Dowager willingly steps down in disgrace. Ultimately, the Sterling family collapses, Lord Ashford's coup fails, and Margaret chooses to leave the palace, embracing a simple life. His Majesty the Emperor restores peace by quelling the unrest and reassuring the people

video:video.video:title: Drunken Sword: Conquer the Demon
video:video.video:description: Caleb Grant, Eva Croft, and allies seek revenge, uncovering a conspiracy involving the Surrey family and demon clans. They rescue Master Gale Croft, defend the Great Wall, and defeat the Surreys, with Eva ascending as the female emperor. Meanwhile, Drew Morris rejects an arranged marriage for Caleb, sparking new conflicts and adventures.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Path Beyond Eternity
video:video.video:description: I love my school beauty wife very much, but I didn't expect that the male mistress would steal my wife! He even turned the tables and accused me of stealing her! Do you think you are rich? Do you want to see that I have a big boss grandfather? He has tens of billions of real estate! How dare you steal my wife!

video:video.video:title: The Wealthy Madame's Top Healer
video:video.video:description: The most beautiful girl in Lunan actually wants to marry Qin Feng! What magical ability does he have that not only wins the favor of the rich woman, but also makes the powerful bow down?

video:video.video:title: Lear, M.D., Lady of Hearts
video:video.video:description: She was killed by her stepmother while possessing a secret book, but she was reborn as an unpopular young lady in ancient times. As soon as she opened her eyes, she was forced to save a handsome boy. Fortunately, the handsome boy asked for a decree granting marriage, but who knew that he was actually Greedy for my body? !

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Celestial Sovereign's Silent Vengeance
video:video.video:description: Cayden Freeman, the Celestial Sovereign of Azra, married Juliette Frost while concealing his identity and secretly supported the Frost family for three years. After intervening to save Alessia Walsh, the second daughter of the Walsh family, from trouble, he earned the enmity of Odin Wells, the Wells heir, and was simultaneously thrown out by Juliette. At an investment banquet, when Cayden faced false accusations and public anger, Alessia appeared and skillfully diffused the situation, marking the beginning of their relationship.

video:video.video:title: Villain Kids? Stepmom Level Up!
video:video.video:description: After transmigrating into the role of a stepmother, Lilith Quimby discovers that she's destined to be killed by her four stepchildren. Determined to change her fate while they're still young, she guides them onto the right path and builds a fortune through business. Just when she thinks she has everything under control, her husband—long presumed dead on the battlefield—returns. And with him comes the shocking truth about his identity...

video:video.video:title: The Cleaner with a Billion-Dollar Secret
video:video.video:description: Female lead is the daughter of the richest man, but pretends to be a cleaner for her boyfriend, andsecretly brings him great benefits. When the female lead thinks that her boyfriend is going topropose to her, she discovers his betrayal. The betrayed female lead reveals her identity but is ridiculed and disbelieved, at this moment the male lead stands up for the female lead and says he will marry her.

video:video.video:title: The Price of my Love
video:video.video:description: After she was killed by the mistress of her husband, she became the daughter of a wealthy man and returned gorgeously!

video:video.video:title: The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness.

video:video.video:title: Bound by Love
video:video.video:description: Aria won Luca’s love in an arranged mafia marriage, but when she secretly helps her sister flee the life, she betrays him. With their families at war and a baby on the way, Aria must decide whether love can survive when loyalty is paid for in blood.

video:video.video:title: After Prison, She is No One's Daughter
video:video.video:description: After serving six years in prison for a crime she didn't commit, Linda returns to the Dalink family only to face further betrayal and abuse. As she uncovers the truth behind the incident that ruined her life, she fights back with the help of Leaf, her childhood protector. Together, they expose the family's dark secrets and bring justice to those who wronged her.

video:video.video:title: I'm pregnant, it's not yours
video:video.video:description: Husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.

video:video.video:title: MOVE ASIDE! IM THE EX BEYOND YOUR REACH!
video:video.video:description: Olivia and Derek die in a car crash on their way to divorce and are reborn as students. Seven years later, Olivia marries billionaire Asher, but a reunion with Derek and Jennifer leads to bullying and humiliation. Can Olivia fight back and take her revenge?

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Awesome Dad
video:video.video:description: A poor boy took his daughter to a martial arts competition to find a wife, but the beautiful CEO despised him because he was a beggar and looked down on him. The next second, the poor boy just moved his fingers and killed everyone in the audience. It turned out that his real identity was the Invincible Immortal, and the beauty was conquered on the spot!

video:video.video:title: OMG! My Divorce Client Is My Billionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: Zoe and Alex met behind masks at a costume party and got married contractrally. Three years later, they cross paths again as strangers. Alex hires Zoe, now a lawyer, to end that marrige, without realizing he's fallen for the very wife he is trying to divorce.

video:video.video:title: The Gambling God Vanished Until the Final Hand
video:video.video:description: With his parents butchered by a gambling syndicate, Peter Gumbel trains under the Gambling God and returns as an unassuming casino waiter. As he defeats one gambling master after another, he protects his loved one's casino, uncovers the truth behind his family's tragedy, and wagers everything for the ultimate revenge.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] L'amour aux champs avec un père célibataire
video:video.video:description: Victime d'un complot orchestré par sa grand-mère et sa sœur, Natalie se retrouve mariée à Rhett, un fermier qui élève seul sa fille muette Ellie. Dès son arrivée, Natalie fait face au rejet d'Ellie et à l'hostilité de la voisine. Au fil des jours, elle réalise que cette voisine abuse en douce de la fillette. Elle tisse peu à peu un lien profond avec Ellie, qui se renforce le jour où la fillette prononce ses premiers mots pour la défendre. Mais alors que Natalie commence enfin à trouver sa place, de nouvelles épreuves surgissent : Ellie subit du harcèlement à l'école et Natalie se retrouve prise entre les conflits de son ancienne et de sa nouvelle famille. Elle jure alors de protéger coûte que coûte l'amour et le foyer qu'elle a si durement bâtis.

video:video.video:title: Marry Again My Billionaire Ex
video:video.video:description: After a tragic crash kills her parents, Alexandra Grey assumes a new identity Adrianna for safety. Years later, Lucien, the man she married for protection, asks for a divorce. Heartbroken, she reclaims her true self and returns to take her father‘s company. But claiming her CEO title requires fulfilling a secret arranged marriage—to Lucien. As the danger escalates, he becomes her unlikely ally, and ultimately, her love.

video:video.video:title: The Queen Bee Strikes Back
video:video.video:description: Bella, heir to the wealthy Walton family, is tired of being surrounded by calculating rich kids. She falls for Marc, a plus-size guy who seems to love her for who she is, hiding her identity and even helping him get recruited to Harvard’s football team. But betrayal hits hard, Bella discovers Marc has been cheating on her with her classmate - and bully - Jessie, who constantly mocks Bella’s body. Even worse, Marc has stolen her identity, claiming he is the Walton heir to win clout and rise to the top of Western High’s social scene. Bella dumps him, has a stunning glow-up, and embraces her curves. When they mock her college future… could Bella’s next move leave them speechless?

video:video.video:title: The Mafia Boss is Addicted to My Touch
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, blindfolded Haley was bedded by Mafia boss Lester. Now ruined by her cheating husband Bill, she signs a healing marriage contract with Lester. Finding out Lester's daughter is her lost newborn secretly sold by Bill, Haley starts a thrilling new life -- slapping down the toxic exes while falling deeply in love with Lester.

video:video.video:title: CEO's Naughty Secret
video:video.video:description: To take back her mother's hotel, she secretly had a baby with a CEO who was drugged and escaped before he woke up. Little did she know, her evil stepsister pretended to be her, making the CEO believe she was his one-night stand. For the sake of the hotel, she had to see him again, but she misunderstood him as being in a relationship with her stepsister, and then she found out she was pregnant...

video:video.video:title: The Betrayed Guardian: The Empire Begs Him Back
video:video.video:description: For ten years, Arthur stood alone against the Abyss. But the new Empress Valeria fell for a pack of lies and branded him a fraud, leaving the entire Empire to despise him. And that’s when the Archfiends emerged from the Abyss.

video:video.video:title: Twin Stars by Moonlight
video:video.video:description: After Yun Momo got drunk one night, he spent an unforgettable night with a mysterious man. However, everything gets complicated when she discovers she's pregnant. In order to give her child a complete family, she signed a contract with the man never to meet again. Bear the responsibility of raising children.

video:video.video:title: From Small-Town Outcast to Blooming Rose
video:video.video:description: As a child loved by no one, Ava suffered unfathomable abuse from her father and grandmother. On the eve of being forced to marry a scoundrel, Ava managed to flee from home with her mother's help. Years later, Ava is now a powerful CEO and returns to rescue her mother, only to walk into her family's trap. But she's a victim no longer - this time, she's back to destroy them all and seize her long-awaited vengeance.

video:video.video:title: Dear Husband, Do you Remember me?
video:video.video:description: An orphan boy turned billionaire CEO, Noah Morgan has spent years searching for the girl who once saved his life, never realizing that she’s been right by his side all along - as his overlooked contract wife and secretary, Mara.

video:video.video:title: The Billionaire Bride Branded a Mistress
video:video.video:description: Mistaken for her fiancé’s mistress and humiliated by his family, secret billionaire Scarlett finally sees Derek for what he is. She walks into their wedding with a new groom, a devastating revenge plan, and enough power to leave every traitor with nothing.

video:video.video:title: Spoiled By The Alpha King With Her Triplets
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, Sister Alicia broke her vows to save a dying werewolf, and was cast out of the Church for carrying his child. Now she slips into the Alpha Estate with her son, a wolf pup carrying royal blood, unaware that the ruthless Alpha King is the boy's father. For six years he has searched for the woman who saved him, while the aging Old Wolf King grows desperate for a pureblood heir. Neither knows she is right under their noses, raising the very heir they've been looking for.

video:video.video:title: Serendipitous Love （DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: The day Sylvia Cooper joined Taylor Corp. marked the day she was wedded to a total stranger named Brian Anders, who promptly disappeared right after they signed the marriage papers.A year later, Liam Taylor, the CEO of Taylor Corp., returned from France.Over time, Liam found himself harboring unique emotions for Sylvia. Liam was also pursuing a divorce. When he arrived at the Courthouse, standing patiently waiting at the entrance was none other than Sylvia…

video:video.video:title: Top Gear Guy Finds His Mrs. Right
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'Top Gear Guy Finds His Mrs. Right' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: Reincarnate to a Princess
video:video.video:description: After she was killed by a classmate, she accidentally traveled to ancient times and became a neglected princess. The prince doted on his concubine and destroyed his wife. He thought that the child in her belly was a bastard outside and left her to fend for herself. Fortunately, she was a doctor. , was able to support her children by her own abilities, and became a famous doctor!

video:video.video:title: The World in My Grasp
video:video.video:description: To marry his girlfriend, Finn Cooper toils as a laborer, enduring long days and surviving on instant noodles to save money, all while facing the scorn of those around him. Deeply troubled by his circumstances, he wishes for strength beyond his current limits. To his astonishment, his wish is granted, but in an unexpected twist. Everyone else becomes as fragile as water, making him the strongest man alive on the planet.

video:video.video:title: Oops! I Cheated with My Legal Wife
video:video.video:description: Handsome Boss got married at a young age? Rumor has it that his wife cheated? And Boss’s married assistant is actually the one he has feelings for? The love square seems a bit crowded, but what if it's actually just the two of them?

video:video.video:title: (Doublage) LA BELLE ENDORMIE
video:video.video:description: Jeune diplômé, Julien Linet, poussé par la maladie de ses parents, se rend au parc pour chercher des opportunités. Par hasard, Mireille Donat cherche un époux pour sa sœur Hélène Varin, gravement malade. Julien accepte la mission, découvre que sa femme est jeune et belle. Grâce à ses soins et son attention, Hélène se rétablit et finit par reconnaître son véritable amour.

video:video.video:title: My Boss Is My Secret Online Dom
video:video.video:description: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious ""Master,"" whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only - ""Cake."" Enemies in real life. Addicted online.

video:video.video:title: Married an Elven King by Mistake
video:video.video:description: New short drama 'Married an Elven King by Mistake' coming soon, please look forward to it.

video:video.video:title: Rigged to Win: Jack of All Cons
video:video.video:description: After witnessing his father’s tragic death due to gambling, Leo Cole vows to take down the industry from the inside. His journey begins by mastering the art of deception under the guidance of a seasoned swindler. With his skills sharpened, he convinces notorious gamblers Harry Lowe and Yves Clark to join him. Teaming up with a cunning thief, Doris Nott, they carefully select the perfect casino, forming an elite crew of con artists.

video:video.video:title: Spoiled By My Boss After Marriage
video:video.video:description: A talented but poor woman finds out her boyfriend cheated on her during an interview. Disappointed, she agrees to a fake engagement with the powerful CEO. Surprisingly, he makes it real and treats her lovingly. Together, they expose the cheaters, leading her to unexpected success. She triumphs over challenges, singing her way to victory.

video:video.video:title: Instant Bride of the Billionaire King
video:video.video:description: The first time men and women met, they got married in the civil government

video:video.video:title: The Undercover Heiress
video:video.video:description: Rosy Xavier, daughter of the wealthiest family in Hanest and wife of Calvin Bale, CEO of Bale Group, is on a mission of vengeance. Her younger sister, Cecilia Xavier, suffered a severe head injury during her internship at Bale Group, leaving her in a vegetative state. Determined to uncover the truth and seek justice, Rosy conceals her identity and infiltrates the company, only to encounter a series of unexpected events.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Thompson, You Found the Wrong Girl
video:video.video:description: The female protagonist, Katie, accidentally stumbles into James's room one drunken night, and they spend the night together, both unaware of each other's true identity. The next morning, Katie realizes that she has "accidentally" had a one-night stand with the company's CEO, James. She tries to downplay the awkward experience, but it leads to more and more intersections in her life with James.

video:video.video:title: The Devil Wears Desire [English]
video:video.video:description: Anna becomes CEO Ian’s secret lover to save her boyfriend. Abandoned by Ian, she dates playboy David. Facing heart failure, she meets Ian disguised as K. Her amnesiac boyfriend Louis returns, manipulated by Annetta. Rescued by crime lord Domenico and forced to marry him, Anna is later kidnapped. Ian and Louis team up to save her, revealing Ian’s true feelings. Amid dark secrets, Anna navigates four men’s obsessions to find true love.

video:video.video:title: When love returns
video:video.video:description: Emily Brooks takes her daughter to the hospital, only to find that the attending physician is none other than Logan Whitmore—her ex-boyfriend who she broke up with seven years ago. Logan doesn’t recognize her, let alone know she secretly gave birth to their daughter. The unexpected reunion brings back painful memories for Emily, yet fate keeps drawing them together, and Logan’s soul recognizes her before his reason does.

video:video.video:title: My 2 Fiancés [English]
video:video.video:description: As Iris and her wealthy boyfriend Rick prepare to marry after seven years together, she sees news of him announcing marriage to another woman. Is Rick being manipulated, or is there more to the story?

video:video.video:title: TITAN SHARK
video:video.video:description: TITAN SHARK

video:video.video:title: The Wealthy Ex-Wife
video:video.video:description: Spencer Clarke was entrusted by his comrade, who passed away three years ago, to take care of his fiancée, Nancy Woods. Faced with Nancy's critical need for a blood transfusion, Anna Ward, concealing her true identity, enters into matrimony with Spencer. Over the subsequent three years, Spencer, unaware of Anna's sacrifice, treats her as nothing more than a blood bank for Nancy.

video:video.video:title: Guardian to Groom
video:video.video:description: Secretly in love with her guardian and Alpha King, Calvin, Nora confesses on her 22st birthday, only to be cold-heartedly rejected. Heartbroken, she joins a lethal mission and takes a fatal hit. Facing her near-death, Calvin finally breaks his restraint—disowning her as guardian to claim her as his soulmate.

video:video.video:title: Legend of the Undead World
video:video.video:description: Legend of the Undead World

video:video.video:title: You Were My Everything, Once(DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: As a token of gratitude, Morgan White agrees to Lily Oswald's grandfather’s request, hiding his true identity as a researcher and marrying into the Oswald family as Lily’s seemingly ordinary husband. For eight years, he tenderly cares for Lily and their child, but her heart remains with her first love, Brett Oswald.

video:video.video:title: Game of Thrones: The Palace Survival
video:video.video:description: Sandy Miller, a modern-day celebrity, unexpectedly time-travels to the past, becoming Zara Miller, the daughter of a renowned general. On her wedding night, she crosses paths with Max Zeller, the third prince. However, a scheme orchestrated by her love rival soon leads to betrayal and heartbreak. Suffering a miscarriage while struggling to establish herself as an entrepreneur, Zara endures countless hardships. Yet, her resilience never wavers.

video:video.video:title: My Heart Has Always Known
video:video.video:description: To save her mom from an abusive relationship with her father, Nina Judd agrees to take the place of her sister, who has vanished, in a marriage alliance with the heir of the powerful Zanes, Sean. Despite supposedly marrying into a life of luxury, she realizes her new husband is a workaholic who has little interest in her. Little does she know, her caring nature melts Sean's cold heart, and what appeared to be a marriage of benefit turns out to be the true love.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping Beside Danger
video:video.video:description: On Jane Shaw's birthday, she barely survives a car accident. But the moment she wakes up, she witnesses a horrifying scene as her husband, Sean Cole, and their maid, Tina Holt, are plotting her death. In an instant, every dream and hope she once had for a happy life in a loving home shatters. The man she loves most has become her greatest enemy, and Jane finds herself trapped like a pawn on a chessboard, waiting to be sacrificed.

video:video.video:title: Condemn Me, My President
video:video.video:description: Sold to the mob by her own boyfriend, Isabella flees straight into the arms of Will Clifton — President of the United States, and the last man she should want. He hides her in his world: quiet debts paid, a White House badge, stolen nights. But loving him this close to power draws enemies fast — an ex, a jealous fiancée, a country watching. The closer she tries to run, the harder he pulls her back.

video:video.video:title: Defying Doom: The Clash of Fate
video:video.video:description: In exchange for his divine powers as the Mystic Lord, Jason Long is destined for a short life. To change his fate, he embarks on a quest for the legendary Volatile. As events unfold, he becomes the live-in “unwanted” boyfriend of Rina Shaw, the heir to the prestigious Shaw family. Determined to protect her from his vengeful ex-girlfriend and a mysterious masked figure, Jason faces a series of challenges.

video:video.video:title: Plan B Bride: She Who Turned the Tables
video:video.video:description: Madge Pearce, a transmigrated daughter, marries into the infamous Marquis Manor in place of her reborn sister. By the time her long-missing husband—rumored to be a womanizer—returns years later, she has already built a fortune of her own. Yet the moment they meet, something about him feels strangely different.

video:video.video:title: The Taste of My Stepbrother
video:video.video:description: Ava is an ordinary college student. While Ava’s mother is excited to remarry to a wealthy man, Ava realizes her step brother is also her lecturer, and more...

video:video.video:title: (Doublage) CONQUÉRIR LE MONDE AVEC MA LAME
video:video.video:description: Arnaud Lemaire descend de sa montagne pour retrouver ses parents, portant un pendentif gravé à son nom. À Rivépole, il sauve Mira Lemaire, poursuivie par la Famille Gervais, et se retrouve mêlé aux conflits des Lemaire. Il découvre un lien entre son pendentif et Élise Laurent, ressent une connexion naturelle avec elle, et doit affronter le mépris de son père Gaston Lemaire. Quand sa mère et sa sœur sont en danger, il décide de révéler sa force pour protéger sa famille.

video:video.video:title: Serve Me! Ball Girl Heiress
video:video.video:description: Ingrid Voss must finish her summer internship at the country club without anyone finding out that she's the heiress to the Voss Empire. However, she meets Jordan Temple, the second son of the powerful Temple Holdings.

video:video.video:title: Cinderella's Story
video:video.video:description: A girl disguises herself as a boy to fulfill a malicious woman's demands, ensuring she and her mother aren't evicted, but unintentionally wins the love of the male lead.

video:video.video:title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
video:video.video:description: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

video:video.video:title: Taming the Football Bad Boy
video:video.video:description: All-pro tight end Tucker Newsome gets a last-chance contract with a strict morality clause—one misstep and it's over. To keep him in line, he’s paired with ambitious PR intern Samira Rivers, who's hiding a secret of her own. Forced to spend every moment together, their chemistry grows undeniable. They can't hook up. They shouldn't fall in love. And everyone is watching.

video:video.video:title: Lost Heiress of Kingston High
video:video.video:description: Katie Walker is the janitor’s adopted kid — bullied, humiliated, a nobody. Then the golden Maddox brothers show up looking for their long lost heiress sister: Katie! But the school’s queen bee steals her place. Now it’s Katie’s turn to level up, take back her crown, and make them all regret underestimating her.

video:video.video:title: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: With the help of his grandfather, Dave Quinn marries Tessa Gray, a girl he does not know much about. After marriage, Tessa works in Quinn Corp as a cleaner and makes Dave promise to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. However, some of her colleagues show disdain towards her, especially Dave’s childhood sweetheart, Lana Harris, who has a crush on him. Out of jealousy, Lana sets Tessa up in an attempt to get rid of her, hoping to ruin her marriage with Dave.

video:video.video:title: Secrets Beneath the Mask
video:video.video:description: The CEO was horrified to discover that the secretary he was pursuing was his ex-wife who had just divorced and had never met him.

video:video.video:title: Crown of the Reborn: Vengeance Awaits (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: On the day of Cade Bale’s wedding, Sue Shaw takes her last breath. Her downfall started when she invited him to go to school in the same Maybach as her out of kindness. Despite Cade being the son of the Shaws’ driver, Sue lent him her card, gifted him luxuries, and even handed over the company her father had left for her. Enjoying everything given by her, Cade got in a relationship, doting on his girlfriend while treating Sue as his maid.

video:video.video:title: Too Late to Say Yes
video:video.video:description: During college, Iris Shaw confesses her love to Paul Snow 99 times, only to be rejected each time. One day, she learns the shocking truth—Paul had fallen for her at first sight but kept turning her down just to enjoy her frustration. Realizing she has been nothing more than his amusement, Iris decides to walk away. To turn the tables on him, she hints at a grand 100th confession a month later—while secretly planning to disappear from his life for good.

video:video.video:title: My Chubby and Clever Princess
video:video.video:description: As a doctor of medicine, I wanted to go to the laboratory to see the special medicine, but I ran into my boyfriend cheating on me. After the accidental explosion in the laboratory, I traveled back to ancient times and turned into the fat wife of the prince! Therefore, I prepared to fight back with my special skills!

video:video.video:title: Goodbye, My Dad's Best Friend
video:video.video:description: Lena falls in love with Elijah, her dad’s best friend, who has always kept her at a distance for some reason. Accidentally carrying his child, Lena plans to leave him for good but their tangled love traps her.

video:video.video:title: Falling Into Ceo's Embrace
video:video.video:description: In order to reject the marriage arranged by his grandmother, Lucas claims that he would only marry if a bride falls from the sky, as it would be God's will. At once, Michelle falls from a tree while trying to save a puppy. To accept 'God's will', Lucas and Michelle hastily get married and then he goes abroad. Michelle, who haven't seen Lucas for four years, falls in love with her boss Lucas at work but hesitates to confess, because of his married status....

video:video.video:title: Warriors of Jiuzhou
video:video.video:description: A boy remembers a girl's gesture as a child for the rest of his life, and many years later, he comes as a god of war to marry her.

video:video.video:title: Rule of Authority and Favor
video:video.video:description: A genius medical doctor traveled through time and became the abandoned concubine of the King of Chu. When she first arrived, she encountered a seriously injured person. She tried to treat him, but was misunderstood and scolded by the hateful King of Chu. Could it be that it is really hard to be a good person?

video:video.video:title: You Are My One And Only
video:video.video:description: Married for two years, yet Marianne has never seen her mysterious husband, Sebastian Walker. After one passionate night with a stranger, she accidentally leaves her roommate's work ID behind. Little does she know that the man from that unforgettable night is her never-met husband—who has just served her with divorce papers. Even worse, Marianne, using the alias Marry Ann, finds herself falling for Sebat Walker, her company's VIP who happens to be married to someone...

video:video.video:title: Don't Mess with the New Guard
video:video.video:description: Don't Mess with the New Guard

video:video.video:title: You're My Wish Come True
video:video.video:description: Reborn at 18, Stella Wood carries memories of her past life and a resolve to change her and her family's fate. While plotting revenge, she approaches Oliver Ford to repay his kindness. She thinks he's just a shy, sweet boy—easily flustered by her teasing. But Oliver isn't truly blind or innocent. By the time Stella wants to free herself from him, she realizes she's the one caught in his game.

video:video.video:title: My Rogue Uncle's Affection
video:video.video:description: A story full of twists and turns. The protagonist Lin Xi decided to change her fate after rebirth and chose to live with Xiao Beizhan. Xiao Beizhan had been rumored to be ill, but Lin Xi's choice was finally proven to be correct. The two not only broke the rumors, but also welcomed three children and lived a happy life.

video:video.video:title: Mommy's Rebel Twins Add to the Trouble
video:video.video:description: A girl comes to the company to apply for a cleaning job, but catches the eye of the CEO? Earning three hundred a day is enough to support the family and even buy toys for the little ones, which is great. But why does she think the little ones look a lot like the CEO?

video:video.video:title: (Doublage) L'ART DE LA CONQUÊTE
video:video.video:description: Après son recrutement, Élise impressionne Antoine en exposant des failles du système. Après une rupture, elle se consacre au travail et gagne son estime par ses rapports percutants et sa perspicacité. Ses compétences exceptionnelles la font entrer dans le champ de vision de ce magnat des affaires.

video:video.video:title: My Wife, The Miracle Healer
video:video.video:description: After being sent to live in the countryside following her mother’s death, Cheryl was taken under the wing of a man who later became her mentor. His guidance enabled her to become an anonymous medical genius known only as "Madame C" to the public. She was soon sent to Southville on a mission to infiltrate the Holberts, and—as fate would have it—she returned home to find that she had been arranged to marry Norman, the Holbert’s scion, when she was still young.

video:video.video:title: La Douce Amertume de la Voir Divorcée ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Irène Roberge, après avoir abandonné son travail pour devenir femme au foyer, est trahie par son mari et humiliée par la maîtresse, puis expulsée sans ménagement, à cinq mois de grossesse. Après le divorce, elle épouse Nicolas Langlois, jeune PDG séduisant. À ses côtés, elle s'épanouit et grandit. Leur mariage, d'abord stratégique, se transforme en amour véritable. Ils se vengent de l'ex-mari et elle réussit enfin sa vie professionnelle et sentimentale.

video:video.video:title: Apocalypse Reborn: Power Grows with Every Woman I Recruit
