video:video.video:description: Transmigrated to a week before doomsday, Edison Clarke awakens the Doomlord System, which multiplies his powers and unlocks abilities as long as he recruits beauties to his team. Despite the devastating environment, Edison leads his army of beauties and crushes his enemies, rewriting the rules of the apocalypse and building an empire of his own.

video:video.video:title: BellyFullofPower:Mama'sMiniMastermind (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Honest, simple country girl Sophia Snyder interns at a hotel when she unexpectedly spends the night with wealthy Shawn Granger. She becomes pregnant and, hearing her baby's thoughts, realizes her past mistakes left them both to suffer. Determined to change their fate, Sophia vows to protect herself and her child. Guided by her unborn child, she rises to wealth, finds true love, and embraces a happy life.

video:video.video:title: With X-Ray Eyes, Desire Ignites
video:video.video:description: Mocked her classmates, Jessie Stark gains x-ray vision suddenly and can spot priceless antiques, predict stocks, and even see illnesses. From hustling in backstreet markets to dominating high-society auctions, Jessie turns her gift into a fortune—all while dodging rivals, outsmarting bullies, and untangling a web of secrets involving Gordon Graham, Leo Lawson, and a mysterious tycoon who knows more about her power than she does.

video:video.video:title: Tuned to Your Heart
video:video.video:description: At five years old, Luna York and William Grant are orphaned and eventually lose contact with each other. Years later, Luna mistakes Wilson Lowe for William and sacrifices her future for him at eighteen—only to face humiliation and mistreatment. Framed for plagiarism, she is rescued by the real William, who recognizes her but hesitates to reunite—until the truth finally comes to light.

video:video.video:title: A Dance Between Chains and Freedom
video:video.video:description: In her past life, Sarah Garner was sent as a hostage and tortured to death. Reborn outside King Cyrus' camp, she chooses a new path—captivating Cyrus with her dance instead of becoming a miserable prostitute. Though kept under threat, Sarah pretends to obey while secretly plotting revenge. She manipulates the man who once abused her and spreads rumors about Cyrus, all while staying close enough to slowly win his heart.

video:video.video:title: When Vengeance Meets Love
video:video.video:description: When Suzanne, the daughter of the Smith family, was kidnapped at a young age, her parents adopted an orphan named Lindsey Smith. Despite Suzanne's eventual reunion with the Smith family, Lindsey couldn't shake the envy stemming from Suzanne's inheritance of the family's wealth. Fueled by this jealousy, Lindsey colluded with Suzanne’s fiancé, James Graham, orchestrating a scheme that tragically claimed Suzanne's mother's life.

video:video.video:title: Out of the Abyss: Ready to Strike
video:video.video:description: Falling into her stepsister Kathy Ford’s trap, Cindy Ford is severely injured and loses the Mystery Box that her biological mother left for her on the night before marrying Miguel Wood. Fortunately, she is saved by the Divine Healer, Ken Shaw. She returns after three years with the medical techniques she learned from Ken and the vast wealth of the Astral Alliance to ruin Kathy and Miguel’s wedding.

video:video.video:title: Not Your Second Choice
video:video.video:description: Growing up in a biased family, Aurora Smith suffers torment from a young age, and Lucas Shaw is the only light in her youth. Even as an adult, she still lives in the shadows of her family's mistreatment and is forced to marry a stranger for three million dollars by her parents and younger brother. Little does she know, a great turning point in fate awaits.

video:video.video:title: From Courtesan to Empress: Taking It Easy
video:video.video:description: Cinderella traveled through time while drunk and became a princess of a fallen country. Her country was destroyed and the leader of the rebels was the prince whom she had tortured for three months. She wanted to lie down and save her life, but the prince fell in love with her. He made her queen and doted on her!

video:video.video:title: The Fallen Hero: From Cliff to Glory
video:video.video:description: After ending the life of Northrealm's lord, Hayes Landon rises as the strongest warrior, only to fall off a cliff during a battle with his treacherous fiancée. Fortunately, Yara York rescues him, sacrificing herself to save his life. Once Hayes recovers, the Storm Clan launches an attack to annihilate the Cloud Sect—Yara’s sect. Determined to protect Yara and her fellow sect members, Hayes steps forward to defend them.

video:video.video:title: Curse Of The Hidden Underdog
video:video.video:description: The Divine King of the Northern Border protects his family and defends his country, and his divine power is limitless. Following the former Divine Kings last wish to marry the Lin familys daughter, he didnt expect that just concealing his identity would cause so much trouble.

video:video.video:title: Queen of Letting Go(English-dubbed)
video:video.video:description: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.

video:video.video:title: A Heart Set Free
video:video.video:description: On the day Cora Irwin is set to marry Gavin Royce, her heart shatters when Gavin chooses Leila Black over her. Devastated, Cora ends their relationship and severs all ties with him. By the time Gavin realizes his mistake and regrets his decision, it is already too late.

video:video.video:title: Reborn, Reviled, and Ridiculously Loved
video:video.video:description: Betrayed, business legend Jane Spencer wakes up as Mira Quill, a rural woman who married the Hewitts' disabled heir in place of her stepsister. Scorned by those around her, she rises in high society and the business world, ultimately bringing down the abusive Quill family and the unfaithful scumbag who framed her.

video:video.video:title: Martial Sisters: Legends of Kung Fu
video:video.video:description: When her younger sister was about to die, the person who came to save her turned out to be her own biological sister who had long since severed ties with her!

video:video.video:title: You in the Darkness
video:video.video:description: She spent the rest of her life repaying her debt because of her parents' fault, but she fell in love with this man who hated her to the core.

video:video.video:title: Five Babies Drop In: The Lucky Wife
video:video.video:description: Zhou Ying'er in modern times weighed 200 jin (a Chinese unit of weight). She was deceived by her half-sister Zhou Yike. On her wedding night, she drugged her wealthy husband, Gu Yanbin, causing him to become disabled. As a result, she was sent to the countryside to stay for five years before getting a divorce. Even after that, Zhou Yike still wanted to harm her. At a critical moment, Zhou Ying'er, an ancient divine doctor, came through time and resolved the crisis. While practicing medicine in the countryside, she unexpectedly became pregnant and gave birth to quintuplets.

video:video.video:title: Love in a Flash Marriage
video:video.video:description: During the engagement party, Li An'an was schemed against by her boyfriend Zhang Wei's family, who were unwilling to even give the 18,000 dowry. After talks over the dowry broke down, Li An'an indignantly called off the engagement. On the spot, the old neighbor Granny Gu wrote a check for 180 million as a dowry to have her grandson Gu Yubai propose to Li An'an. At this time, Li An'an was informed by her aunt that she had to sell her grandmother's house to gather the funds to keep it. Willing to marry Gu Yubai to save her grandmother's house, Li An'an stated on the spot that she would agree to the marriage under the condition that the dowry be 180,000, leading Gu Yubai to misunderstand her as a gold-digger who trades feelings for money. Under his grandmother's pressure, Gu Yubai reluctantly registered the marriage with Li An'an, but he concealed his identity as a wealthy tycoon. Gu Yubai went to great lengths, causing a series of humorous mishaps, all in an effort to keep his CEO identity under wraps…

video:video.video:title: Derniers Mots de l'Amour ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Mariée trois ans à Nathan Vaude, Léa Dante découvre son cancer le jour de sa 99e infidélité. Elle exige le divorce, après cinq missions. Sous l'identité de l'artiste Rosette, elle orchestre sa vengeance : elle déterre la vérité sur l'accident, expose le complot des médicaments et anéantit la façade de Viviane Brizard. Quand Nathan découvre la vérité, il se livre à la police. Trop tard. Léa lui laisse une dernière lettre, la troisième, son adieu.

video:video.video:title: The Wife's Counterattack [English]
video:video.video:description: Ouyang Mu married Liang Muqing only for Mu Qing's family property, but behind his back, he had already been involved with Mu Qing's best friend Li Feier, and Mu Qing already knew all this

video:video.video:title: The Childhood Friend I Couldn't Resist
video:video.video:description: Ethan, the richest man in the Capital, met the spirited young Sia while recovering from a serious childhood illness. Her encouragement helped him survive, but she disappeared before their promised reunion. Eighteen years later, they meet again. Afraid of losing her, Ethan rushes into marriage, only to discover that Sia has been part of the plan all along. From the very start, their love has been a two-way chase, culminating in a long-awaited, perfect ending.

video:video.video:title: The Wife Who Burned
video:video.video:description: Betrayed and framed, Katniss Frost returns under a new identity with her son. With vengeance in her heart and a mission to save her critically ill daughter, she decides to confront her ex-husband, Garrick Unwin. But this time, he's the one who's going to burn.

video:video.video:title: My CEO Son Kicks The Adopted Traitor
video:video.video:description: Joyce Shaw has been secretly drugged for years by her adopted son Felix and his wife, set to be a “heart donor” for his mother-in-law. On the eve of surgery, she uncovers the deadly plot and flees. Billionaire Jason Shaw recognizes her birthmark and confirms she’s his lost mother. But can he save her before it’s too late...?

video:video.video:title: Princess in Disguise: The Healer Who Saved a Dynasty
video:video.video:description: The seventh princess, Ariana Zeller, grows up among commoners while the emperor and her three brothers search for her. Saved by the former sect leader of the Sacred Healers, she rises to become the sect’s new leader. However, she hides her identity and repays a favor by marrying the top scholar—who secretly plots against her. Meanwhile, the princes arrive to reunite with their long-lost sister.

video:video.video:title: Back to Win It All
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by Elise Rowan, Nathan Chandler dies saving his daughter, Lila. Back in the '90s with a second shot, he cuts ties with Elise, builds his fortune, and heads for Southmere. But the past isn't done with him—and this time, he's ready!

video:video.video:title: The Crown Beyond the Grave
video:video.video:description: Once a top model, betrayed and left for dead—now she returns, stunning and unstoppable, ready for the ultimate revenge.

video:video.video:title: My Wife and Daughter Got Superpower
video:video.video:description: Nine Dragons with a Coffin transported Luke Hayes to the Otherworld. By the time he came back, his wife had been cast aside by her family, and his daughter had suffered abuse. To protect them from future harm, Luke fed them dragon meat. Now both his wife and daught got power to protect themselves.
